description: This file defines an interface for content decryption and a DataExchange class for handling media encryption data, including methods for setting and retrieving encryption parameters, managing buffers, and handling decryption sessions.

classes.name: IContentDecryption
classes.description: Interface providing access to a content decryption module, including initialization, session management, and notification handling.

classes.name: DataExchange
classes.description: Class for managing encrypted media data, including setting encryption parameters, managing buffers, and media properties.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the content decryption with a service shell.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the content decryption with a service shell.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the content decryption state.

methods.name: Systems
methods.description: Returns an iterator over available systems.

methods.name: Designators
methods.description: Returns an iterator over designators for a given key system.

methods.name: Sessions
methods.description: Returns an iterator over sessions for a given key system.

methods.name: initializationStatus
methods.description: Notification callback for initialization status updates.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the encryption parameters and media properties.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Sets or gets the current status of the data exchange.

methods.name: InitWithLast15
methods.description: Sets or gets the flag for initializing with last 15 seconds.

methods.name: SetIV
methods.description: Sets the initialization vector (IV) for encryption.

methods.name: SetEncScheme
methods.description: Sets the encryption scheme.

methods.name: EncScheme
methods.description: Gets the encryption scheme.

methods.name: SetEncPattern
methods.description: Sets the encryption pattern with blocks.

methods.name: EncPattern
methods.description: Gets the encryption pattern blocks.

methods.name: SubSampleLength
methods.description: Returns the number of subsamples.

methods.name: SubSamples
methods.description: Returns the subsample information.

methods.name: SubSample
methods.description: Sets subsample information.

methods.name: SetMediaProperties
methods.description: Sets media stream properties like height, width, and type.

methods.name: MediaProperties
methods.description: Retrieves media stream properties.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data into the buffer.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the buffer.

methods.name: IVKey
methods.description: Returns the IV key data.

methods.name: IVKeyLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the IV key.

methods.name: KeyId
methods.description: Sets or gets the key ID.
